verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ājīvako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, an Ājīvaka ascetic with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, abrahmacārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
verses.english: They kill living creatures, steal, have sex, lie, and consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato ājīvako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye”ti.
verses.english: An Ājīvaka ascetic with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.”
